applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 was answered and therefore whether it could count as an unanswered witness.
quote: Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge says the point was answered by both sides, so it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness.
